_readme: Operational notices shown in the strip under the site header.
Edit this file only — no code change is needed, and the site picks it up on the next load.
id     unique short string. Changing it makes the notice reappear for people who dismissed it.
level  'info' | 'warn' | 'urgent'  — controls the colour of the dot and bar.
text   one sentence. Keep it under about 120 characters so it fits on a phone.
url    optional. Omit the field entirely if there is nothing to link to.
from   YYYY-MM-DD. Not shown before this date.
until  YYYY-MM-DD. Hidden from the START of this date, so use the day AFTER it should stop.
Anything outside its from/until window is skipped, so an expired notice disappears
on its own rather than sitting on the site months later. Leave 'alerts' as an empty
list when there is nothing to say — the strip then does not render at all.

_example.text: Chattogram Port: berth waiting extended to 4 days. Allow extra transit time on export bookings.
